correctness.rationale: On the real Hilbert space of Hermitian matrices, normalized circular complex off-diagonal variance1 makes standard GUE covariance the identity, so T=I+D*(Sigma-I)D even when Sigma is singular. A unitary preserves the centered Gaussian law exactly when Ad_U commutes with S=D*A D. Differentiating at skew-Hermitian K and testing E_ii forces K_ab(A_bi−A_ai)=0; therefore its Lie algebra is block diagonal for identical-row classes of A. Block-trace representation S(X)=sum a_ab Tr(P_b X)P_a proves every U(C_a) symmetry. Normalizers of this identity component permute the primitive central block projectors; their coordinate permutations preserve the law iff P Sigma P^T=Sigma. This establishes G=(prod U(C_a)) Aut_perm(Sigma), the component quotient and dimension, and full U(M) iff Sigma=I+b11^T with b>=−1/M. I independently tested general complex Haar block rotations, non-symmetry of cross-block rotations, and an example with eigenvalue1 but distinct rows. Tests are finite corroboration; the compact Lie normalizer proof is unrestricted.
